verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a hosted gateway that stores request logs. The evidence only shows logs viewable in the dashboard, per-request log controls, and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. That endpoint eases switching providers but does not export your stored data. Nothing documents a bulk export of logs, configs or metrics in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
